report.summary: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable encountered when checking notification preferences for user profiles with None preferences.
report.root_cause: The function get_user_notification_preference in shopapp/users.py directly subscripted user["preferences"][channel] without checking if user["preferences"] was None. When guest or migrated users without preferences (such as usr_002) are queried during order confirmation notification dispatch, user["preferences"] evaluates to None, raising a TypeError. This was introduced by commit 1f3a4df which removed previous safe null-checking logic.

evidence.why_relevant: Direct dictionary subscripting on user["preferences"] without verifying whether it is None.
